segments.text: Blue shirt, red bicycle, rolling past the pier
I was posted up right here, now you're pulling near
Keys in your hand, you nodded at the waves like
Slow down, take your time, let the heart weep fade
She's an out, she's an out, she's an out

Is it now? Is it now? Is it now? With you by my side? Is it now? Is it now? No need to run Is it now? Is it now? We hold the sun Is it now? Is it now? Keep it loose, keep it low Is it now? Let it drift, let it go Is it now? Is it now? We're good where we are Is it now? Is it now? Is it now? Just two small sparks
I got a, oh, yeah, I got a, oh, yeah
Vendor at the corner calling mango sweet
And the tide tapping time with our feet
Your laugh hit the air like a hand drum roll
I forgot the list, forgot the bills
Ice, ice, ice cup sweating on the rail by the step
You said don't think too hard
Well I did it not yet
You took my sleeve and spun me once like none of it was last
Keep it loose, keep it low
Let it drift, let it go
If the rain comes down, we stay out in it
If the day runs long, we still move with it
And in my hand, no speech, no show
If the sky turns grey, we don't hold it
We lean right back, let the whole thing spin
You and me, same pace, same warning shoes
Keep it loose, keep it long
Let it drip, let it go
We're ready, we're ready, we're easy now
